title: Parse a noun phrase
subtitle: Article → modifiers → noun → function.
overview: Make one grammatical decision at a time: find the article, collect agreeing words, identify the head noun, then ask what the phrase does in the clause.
A long phrase becomes manageable when you keep its boundaries visible.

items.en: We see the word of God.

items.grc: μένει ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ τοῦ θεοῦ.
items.en: He or she remains in the love of God.
The disciples of the Lord hear.
